title: MERRY CHRISTMAS JESUS CHRIST
text: Beloved, I want you to do me a favor right now. Before we go any further into this divine encounter, I want you to share this message [music] with someone. There's somebody in your family, there's somebody in your workplace, there's somebody in your neighborhood who needs to hear what the spirit of God is about to release through this platform. Don't keep it to yourself. The anointing that breaks the yoke is not meant to be hoarded, it is meant to be shared. So, pause for a moment, share this broadcast, send it to that WhatsApp group, post it [music] on your timeline, because what God is about to do in the next few moments will shift atmospheres and change destinies. Share it now, and let's proceed. Glory be to God. Merry Christmas, Jesus Christ. You see, that statement is not just a greeting. It is a prophetic declaration. It is an acknowledgement of the greatest invasion that ever took place in human history. When we say Merry Christmas, Jesus Christ, we are celebrating the fact that deity clothed himself in humanity, that the infinite became finite, that the uncreated one stepped into creation, that the word became flesh and tabernacled among us. This is not just a religious festival. This is the commemoration of the most strategic intervention that heaven ever orchestrated on behalf of the earth. John chapter 1 verse 14 says, "And the word was made flesh and dwelt among us, and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father, full of grace and truth." That word dwelt in the Greek is kanoo, which means to pitch a tent, to tabernacle. Jesus didn't just visit, he came to stay. He came to establish a permanent covenant, a new and living way. And when he came, he didn't come in the splendor that the religious minds of that day expected. He came in a manger, in a feeding trough for animals, in the most humble circumstances, because God was making a statement, "I am accessible to all. My salvation is not for the elite. It is for whosoever will." The birth of Jesus Christ is the fulfillment of prophecy. For centuries, the prophets had spoken about his coming. Isaiah chapter 7 verse 14 declared, "Therefore, the Lord himself shall give you a sign. Behold, a virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel." Immanuel means God with us. You see, the problem of humanity from the Garden of Eden was separation from God. When Adam sinned, he lost the glory, he lost the presence, he lost the fellowship. But in the fullness of time, God said, "I will restore what was lost. I will come down and be with my people again." And so, Jesus was born, not just to be admired, not just to be worshipped from a distance, but to be Immanuel, God dwelling among us, God walking with us, God restoring the lost fellowship. Micah chapter 5 verse 2 prophesied about the place of his birth. "But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel, whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting." Bethlehem, the city of David, the house of bread. Jesus, who is the bread of life, was born in the house of bread. Everything about his birth was prophetic, everything was intentional, [music] everything was designed by divine intelligence to communicate spiritual realities that would transform the trajectory of humanity. When the angels appeared to the shepherds in Luke chapter 2, they didn't just bring good news, they brought the gospel. Verse 10 says, "Fear not, for behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people." This was not localized good news. This was universal good news. The Messiah had come, not just for the Jews, but for all people, Jew and Gentile, bond and free, male and female. And then in verse 11, the angel said, "For unto you is born this day in the city of David, a savior, which is Christ the Lord." Three titles in one declaration, savior, Christ, and Lord. He came to save us from sin, he came as the anointed one to destroy the works of the devil, and he came as Lord to establish the kingdom of God. You see, the birth of Jesus was not just a historical event, it was a prophetic invasion. Second Corinthians chapter 4 verse 4 tells us that the God of this world has blinded the minds of them which believe not. Satan had established a kingdom of darkness, a regime of oppression, a system of bondage. But when Jesus was born, a counter kingdom was introduced. Matthew chapter 4 verse 17 records that Jesus began to preach, saying, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand." The kingdom had arrived in the person of the king. Wherever Jesus went, >> [music] >> the kingdom manifested. The sick were healed, the oppressed were delivered, the dead were raised, because the king was present, and where the king is, the kingdom is. Now, let me prophesy to someone here. The same Jesus who was born over 2,000 years ago is alive today. He's not a dead religious figure. He is the resurrected Lord, seated at the right hand of the majesty on high, and he's interceding for you. Hebrews chapter 7 verse 25 says, "Wherefore, he is able also to save them to the uttermost >> [music] >> that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them." Whatever you are facing today, whatever battle you are fighting, whatever mountain stands before you, Jesus is interceding for you. His birth was the beginning of your redemption. His death was the payment for your sins. His resurrection was the guarantee of your victory, and his intercession is the assurance that you will prevail. The Christmas season is a time to reflect on the love of God. John chapter 3 verse 16, the most famous verse in the Bible, says, "For God so loved the world that he gave his only begotten son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life." God's love was not expressed in words alone, it was demonstrated in action. He gave his son. Romans chapter 5 verse 8 says, "But God commended [music] his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died [music] for us." He didn't wait for us to become righteous. He came while we were still in sin, while we were still lost, while we were still separated from him. That is the nature of divine love, sacrificial, unconditional, transformative. And because Jesus came, you and I have access to the Father. Ephesians chapter 2 verse 18 says, "For through him we both have access by one spirit unto the Father." Before Christ, there was a veil in the temple that separated the Holy of Holies from the rest of the temple. Only the high priest could enter once a year with the blood of atonement. But when Jesus died on the cross, Matthew chapter 27 verse 51 records that the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom. GOD himself tore the veil, signifying that the way into his presence [music] was now open to all who believe. We are no longer separated, we are reconciled, we are no longer strangers, we are sons and daughters. We are no longer servants, we are friends of God. Let me pray for somebody right now. Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the gift of your son. I thank you that through him, we have access to your presence, to your power, to your [music] promises. And I decree over every person hearing this message right now, every veil of limitation is torn today. Every barrier that the enemy has erected to keep you from your divine destiny is shattered by the power of the Holy Ghost. You will not be denied access to the Father, you will not be denied access to your inheritance, you will not be denied access to your prophetic destiny. The blood of Jesus has [music] qualified you. The name of Jesus has empowered you. The spirit of God has anointed [music] you. And I release upon you a fresh baptism of boldness to approach the throne of grace with confidence to obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need. [music] In the name of Jesus, receive it now. Now, there's something prophetic I want to show you about the birth of Jesus. When he was born, the Bible says in Luke chapter 2 verse 7, "And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn." There was no room in the inn. This is prophetic. Even today, many people have no room for Jesus in their lives. They have room for their careers, room for their ambitions, room for their pleasures, but no room for the King of kings. They celebrate Christmas with all the festivities, the gifts, the decorations, but they leave Jesus out. They honor the holiday, but dishonor the one who is the reason for the season. But I prophesy to you, make room for Jesus this season. Not just in your celebrations, but in your heart, in your home, in your business, in your decisions. Let him be Lord over every area of your life. Colossians chapter 1 verse 18 says, "And he is the head of the body the church who is the beginning the first born from the dead that in all things he might have the preeminence he must have preeminence he must be first when you give him first place everything else will fall into divine order your finances will align your relationships will align your health will align your destiny will align because the one who holds all things together is now at the center of your life the wise men when they heard about the birth of Jesus came from the east to worship him Matthew chapter 2 verse 2 says where is he that is born king of the Jews for we have seen his star in the east and are come to worship him these were Gentiles men who were not part of the covenant community of Israel yet they recognized the significance of his birth and traveled great distances to honor him and when they found him verse 11 says they fell down and worshipped him and when they had opened their treasures they presented unto him gifts gold and frankincense and myrrh they gave him their best they didn't come with empty hands they came with sacrificial offerings this Christmas what are you presenting to Jesus what are you offering to the king your worship your obedience your surrender your time your resources the wise men gave gold representing his kingship frankincense representing his priesthood and myrrh representing his suffering and death they prophetically acknowledge who he was and what he came to do and when you give to Jesus you are not impoverishing yourself you are investing in the kingdom you are sowing into eternity Luke chapter 6 verse 38 says give and it shall be given unto you good measure pressed down and shaken together and running over shall men give into your bosom now let me pray specifically for someone who has been struggling financially father in the name of Jesus I come against every spirit of lack and poverty that has attached itself to your child I decree that this Christmas season marks a turning point in their financial life just as the wise men brought gifts to Jesus I decree that divine provisions are coming to you from unexpected sources you will receive gifts you will receive favor you will receive opportunities that will catapult you into a new dimension of abundance the windows of heaven are opening over your life and blessings that you cannot contain are being poured out upon you no more struggling no more lack no more insufficiency this is your season of overflow in the name of Jesus receive it the birth of Jesus also represents new beginnings 2 Corinthians chapter 5 verse 17 says therefore if any man be in Christ he is a new creature all things are passed away behold all things are become new when you receive Jesus you are not just reformed you are transformed you are not just improved you are recreated you receive a new nature a new identity a new destiny the past no longer defines you the blood of Jesus has washed it away the failures no longer condemn you the grace of God has covered them the limitations no longer restrict you the spirit of God has empowered you I prophesy to someone this Christmas is your season of new beginnings that business that failed will be resurrected that relationship that was broken will be restored that dream that was deferred will be revived that calling that was buried will be reactivated God is doing a new thing in your life and you will not miss it Isaiah chapter 43 verse 19 says behold I will do a new thing now it shall spring forth shall you not know it I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert where there was no way God is making a way where there was dryness God is releasing streams of blessing this is your time this is your season this is your moment of divine visitation let me also address the spiritual significance of this season Christmas is not just about the birth of Jesus it is about the manifestation of light in darkness John chapter 1 verse 5 says and the light shineth in darkness and the darkness comprehended it not Jesus came as the light of the world John chapter 8 verse 12 records his declaration I am the light of the world he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness but shall have the light of life in a world filled with confusion deception and evil Jesus came to bring clarity truth and righteousness and now as believers we are called to be carriers of that light Matthew chapter 5 verse 14 says ye are the light of the world a city that is set on a hill cannot be hid you are not just a recipient of light you are a distributor of light everywhere you go the light of God should shine through you your workplace should be brighter because you are there your family should be more peaceful because you are there your community should be more blessed because you are there you are a city set on a hill and you cannot be hidden I release upon you right now a fresh anointing to shine every cloud of darkness that has overshadowed your life is dispelled by the light of God every work of witchcraft every assignment of the enemy every plan of darkness against your destiny is exposed and destroyed by the power of the Holy Ghost you will shine brighter this season than you have ever shown before your light will attract divine opportunities divine connections divine favor people will see your good works and glorify your father which is in heaven in the name of Jesus arise and shine for your light has come the birth of Jesus also inaugurated spiritual warfare when Jesus was born Herod the king at that time was troubled and all Jerusalem with him Matthew chapter 2 verse 3 Herod's response to the birth of the king was to seek to destroy him he ordered the slaughter of all male children in Bethlehem who were 2 years old and under but God in his sovereignty had already warned Joseph in a dream to take the child and his mother and flee to Egypt you see from the very beginning there was opposition to the purposes of God the enemy knew that this child was a threat to his kingdom and so he sought to eliminate him but glory be to God the plans of the enemy failed then and they will fail now no weapon formed against you shall prosper Isaiah chapter 54 verse 17 every plot every scheme every conspiracy against your life and destiny is frustrated by the power of God the same God who protected Jesus in his infancy is the same God who is protecting you today Psalm 91 verse 11 says for he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways you are surrounded by divine protection you are covered by the blood of Jesus you are shielded by the power of the Most High let me pray father in the name of Jesus I decree that every Herod in the life of the person hearing this message is judged by fire every evil king every wicked authority every demonic personality that has been assigned to cut short their destiny is destroyed by your power I command every arrow of the enemy fired against them to backfire I decree that every trap set for them catches the enemy instead they will live and not die they will fulfill their divine assignment they will accomplish everything you have ordained for their lives in the name of Jesus I seal this prayer with the blood of the lamb amen now let's talk about the purpose of his coming 1 John chapter 3 verse 8 says for this purpose the son of God was manifested that he might destroy the works of the devil Jesus didn't come just to be a good teacher or a moral example he came on a rescue mission he came to destroy the works of the devil what are the works of the devil sickness poverty bondage oppression sin death all of these are the works of the devil and Jesus came to destroy them when he began his ministry he went about doing good and healing all that were oppressed of the devil Acts chapter 10 verse 38 everywhere he went captives were set free the blind received their sight the lame walked the lepers were cleansed the deaf heard the dead were raised and the poor had the gospel preached to them Matthew chapter 11 verse 5 this was not just compassion this was the kingdom of God in demonstration this was light dispelling darkness this was life conquering death and today the same Jesus is still in the business [music] of destroying the works of the devil if you are sick he's your healer if you are bound he's your deliverer if you are oppressed he's your liberator if you are in sin he's your savior whatever the devil has done in your life Jesus has the power to undo it whatever the enemy has stolen Jesus has the authority to restore it this Christmas I decree that you will experience the delivering power of Jesus Christ every chain is broken every yoke is destroyed every cage is open you are free indeed for whom the son sets free is free indeed. Let me also speak to the issue of reconciliation. Christmas is a celebration of reconciliation between God and man. Romans chapter 5 verse 10 says, "For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his son, much more being reconciled, we shall be saved by his [music] life." We were enemies of God because of sin, but through Jesus, we have been reconciled. The hostility has been removed. The enmity has been abolished. The separation has been bridged. And now, as reconciled children, we have been given the ministry of reconciliation. 2 Corinthians chapter 5 verse 18 says, "And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation." You are an ambassador of reconciliation. You are called to bring people back to God, to show them the way of salvation, to introduce them to Jesus. This Christmas, don't just celebrate with believers. Reach out to the lost. Share the gospel with that family member who doesn't know Jesus. Invite that colleague to church. Be a witness in your sphere of influence. I decree that this season, your testimony will win souls for the kingdom. Your life will be a living epistle, read and known by all men. People will see the transformation in you and desire what you have. You will be a soul winner, a fisher of men, a laborer in the harvest field. And when you stand before Jesus, you will hear him say, "Well done, good and faithful servant." In the name of Jesus, receive this grace. Merry Christmas, Jesus Christ. This is a declaration of celebration, but it is also a call to action. Jesus came to save us, but he also came to commission us. Mark chapter 16 verse 15 says, "Go ye into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature." This is not optional. It is a command. Every believer is called to be a witness, to carry the message of salvation to a dying world. And as we celebrate this season, let us remember those who are less fortunate. Let us extend the love of Christ to the poor, the needy, the widow, the orphan. James chapter 1 verse 27 says, "Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world." True Christianity is not just about receiving blessings. It is about being a blessing. It is not just about being ministered to. It is about ministering to others. I prophesy that as you give this season, as you sow into the lives of others, God will open up fountains of blessing in your own life. Proverbs chapter 11 verse 25 says, "The liberal soul shall be made fat, and he that watereth shall be watered also himself." You cannot outgive God. Whatever you sow, you will reap in abundance. Be generous, be compassionate, be kind. Let the love of Christ flow through you to a world that desperately needs it. Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for this glorious season. I thank you for the birth of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. I thank you that through him, we have life and have it more abundantly. And now, Father, I lift up every person who has heard this message. I decree that this Christmas will be the best they've ever experienced. I decree supernatural breakthroughs, divine encounters, prophetic fulfillments, and uncommon testimonies. I decree that the joy of the Lord will fill their hearts, that peace will guide their minds, and that the presence of God will rest upon their homes. Every curse is broken. Every limitation is removed. Every obstacle is cleared. This is their season of acceleration, their season of manifestation, their season of divine favor. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I seal this prayer and this declaration. Let the fire of the Holy Ghost consume every work of darkness, and let the glory of God fill every life. Amen and amen.
